top_signals.title: Zelenskyy warns Putin is preparing for escalation by bringing in North Korean military equipment
top_signals.summary: His comments come shortly after deadly Russian attacks on cities across Ukraine overnight.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India Equity Fund Flows Ease in July as Small Caps Stay Hot
top_signals.summary: Flows into Indian equity funds moderated in July even as investors continued to pour money into small- and mid-cap strategies amid global headwinds including a spike in oil prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
